content: Comparing SPICE curves for three datasets shown in Figure FIGREF9-FIGREF9, they suggest an increase in task complexity, but they do not reflect the successively closing gap of caption truthfulness scores between two Existential datasets, or the substantial difference in caption truthfulness between captions on Existential-MultiShapes and Spatial-MultiShapes.
